Managed Cloud Hosting Myths That Refuse to Die

Quick thread 🧵
Managed cloud hosting runs the operational layer for you (provisioning, patching, SSL, backups, firewall) while you keep SSH, your stack, your code, and your data.
It's standard Linux, so there's no lock-in.
It scales by resizing and by adding servers behind a load balancer.
And "one dashboard" doesn't mean one cloud: on Kloudbean it spans seven providers and every major language, not just WordPress.
